_source: Tax Foundation, 2025 State Income Tax Rates and Brackets (https://taxfoundation.org/data/all/state/state-income-tax-rates/ ; the -2025 URL now 404s) incl. its xlsx https://taxfoundation.org/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/2025-State-Individual-Income-Tax-Rates-and-Brackets-2025.xlsx ; updated/cross-checked with official 2025 state forms mirrored at https://taxsim.nber.org/historical_state_tax_forms/ (CA 540, AZ 140i, AR DFA indexed brackets, CO 104, DC D-40, ID EIN00046, ME rate schedule, MO-1040, MT tax tables, ND booklet, NM PIT rates, OR Pub 17, SC IIT packet, UT TC-40 instr, VT booklet, WI Form 1 instr) and 2025 legislative summaries (EY Tax News: GA HB 111, ID HB 40, OH HB 96, MD HB 352, WI Act 15, VA HB 1600, WV SB 2033).
_notes: Single filer, no dependents, wage income only, full-year resident. brackets = [lower threshold of state taxable income, marginal rate]. Taxable income ~= wages - standardDeduction - personalExemption (state-specific AGI adjustments, e.g. pre-tax 401k/HSA treatment, federal-tax deductions in AL/MO/OR, are ignored); personalCredit is a nonrefundable credit subtracted from tax (floor 0). Mid-2025 retroactive law changes supersede the Feb-2025 Tax Foundation table for GA, ID, OH, SC, MD, WI, VA, UT, AR (indexed), CA, OR, VT (TF used 2024 widths for some). Federal std deduction for 2025 is $15,750 after OBBBA; states whose std deduction tracks federal use $15,750 only where rolling conformity was confirmed (CO, ND, MO, AZ; UT credit base) or assumed (MT, NM); SC, ID, ME, DC use $15,000. Phase-outs, recapture provisions (CT, NY), AMT-style minimums (VT), and income-dependent deduction sliding scales (WI, AL, MN) are described in notes but not encoded in brackets. Payroll-type employee taxes (CA SDI, NJ/NY/RI/HI TDI, MA/WA/CT/OR paid leave, WA Cares) are excluded. Linear phase-outs (creditPhaseout / deductionPhaseout / exemptionPhaseout: amount minus rate × (income − start), floored at 0) are modeled for UT, WI (approximate), CT and CA; other phase-outs and recaptures described in notes are not.

local.note: Local income taxes are EXCLUDED. Significant ones not modeled: NYC (3.078-3.876%) and Yonkers (NY); Maryland county taxes (2.25-3.3%, applies to all MD residents); Ohio municipal (1-2.5%) and school district taxes; Pennsylvania local EIT (~1%, Philadelphia ~3.75%); Indiana county taxes (~0.5-3.4%); Michigan city taxes (Detroit 2.4%); Kentucky occupational taxes; Missouri (Kansas City, St. Louis 1%); Alabama occupational taxes; Wilmington DE 1.25%; Iowa school surtaxes; Oregon Portland Metro SHS / Multnomah PFA; Denver/Aurora OPT; Newark payroll tax (employer).

AK.notes: No state tax on wage income.

AL.notes: Std deduction $3,000 for AGI<=$25,999, reduced $25 per $500 of AGI above that, floor $2,500 (reached ~AGI $35,500). Federal income tax paid is deductible from AL taxable income (not modeled). Local occupational taxes (e.g. Birmingham 1%) not modeled.

AR.notes: 2025 DFA indexed brackets for net income <= $94,700. Above that, the low-bracket benefit is clawed back: tax = 3.9% x income minus an adjustment that shrinks from $419.96 to $89.30 by ~$97,800 (i.e. above ~$97.8k effectively 3.9% minus $89.30). Personal credit $29 (nonrefundable). Std deduction $2,410 (TF).

AZ.notes: Flat 2.5%. Std deduction tied to federal; AZ 2025 Form 140 instructions give $15,750 (post-OBBBA federal amount).

CA.notes: 2025 FTB figures (Form 540: std ded $5,706, exemption credit $153). Top bracket includes 1% Mental Health Services Tax over $1M. Exemption credit phases out $6 per $2,500 of federal AGI above ~$244k. Excludes CA SDI payroll tax (1.2% of all wages in 2025, no cap).

CO.notes: Flat 4.4%. Starting point is federal taxable income, so the federal std deduction ($15,750 post-OBBBA) applies. High earners (AGI >= ~$300k single) must add back deductions above $12,000. Denver/Aurora etc. occupational privilege taxes (small flat monthly) not modeled.

CT.notes: No std deduction. $15,000 personal exemption phases out $1,000 per $1,000 of CT AGI above $30,000 (gone at $45,000). 2% bracket phases out above $56,500 AGI and a benefit recapture applies above $105,000/$200,000 AGI (up to $3,150 extra) - not modeled. Personal tax credits (1-75%) for low incomes not modeled. CT Paid Leave 0.5% payroll not modeled.

DC.notes: DC std deduction is $15,000 for 2025 per DC D-40 booklet (DC did not adopt OBBBA $15,750).

DE.notes: Personal credit $110. Wilmington 1.25% city wage tax not modeled.

FL.notes: No state tax on wage income.

GA.notes: Flat rate cut to 5.19% for 2025 by HB 111 (2025), retroactive to 1/1/2025 (TF table shows 5.39%, pre-cut).

HI.notes: 2025 brackets widened by Act 46 (2024). HI TDI payroll not modeled.

IA.notes: Flat 3.8% (2025). $40 personal exemption credit. Some school district surtaxes not modeled.

ID.notes: Rate cut to 5.3% for 2025 by HB 40 (2025), retroactive; zero bracket $4,811 per ID 2025 instructions. Idaho conforms to IRC as of 1/1/2025, so std deduction is pre-OBBBA $15,000.

IN.notes: Flat 3.0%. County income taxes (~0.5%-3.4%, avg ~1.5%+) apply to all residents - not modeled.

KY.notes: Flat 4.0% (2025). Local occupational license taxes (often 1-2.5%) not modeled.

LA.notes: Flat 3.0% from 2025 (Act 11 of 2024); std deduction $12,500 replaces personal exemption.

MA.notes: 5% flat plus 4% millionaire surtax on income over $1,083,150 (2025). PFML payroll (~0.46% employee share) not modeled.

MD.notes: HB 352 (2025 BRFA), retroactive to 1/1/2025: new 6.25% (>$500k) and 6.5% (>$1M) brackets; std deduction becomes flat $3,350 (was 15% of AGI, $1,800-$2,700; TF table predates this). $3,200 exemption halves at AGI>$100k, quarter at >$125k, zero at >$150k. Also 2% capital-gains surtax for FAGI>$350k (not wage). County 'piggyback' income tax 2.25%-3.3% on top - large, NOT modeled.

ME.notes: 2025 MRS schedule. Std deduction phases out for income over ~$100k single; personal exemption phases out above ~$324k. Maine's 2025 std deduction is $15,000 per its 2025 instructions (not updated to OBBBA $15,750).

MI.notes: Flat 4.25%. City income taxes (Detroit 2.4%, others ~1%) not modeled.

MN.notes: Std deduction reduced for AGI > $238,950 (3% of excess, 10% above $330,300, max 80% reduction). 1% NII surtax over $1M (not wage).

MO.notes: Top rate 4.7% (2025). MO std deduction equals the federal std deduction claimed ($15,750 post-OBBBA). Limited federal income tax deduction phases out with AGI (not modeled). Kansas City and St. Louis 1% earnings taxes not modeled.

MT.notes: 2025 MT DOR table. Starting point is federal taxable income, so federal std deduction applies; $15,750 assumes MT follows the OBBBA increase (UNSURE - could be $15,000).

ND.notes: 2025 ND booklet brackets. Starting point is federal taxable income with perpetual conformity, so OBBBA federal std deduction $15,750 applies.

NH.notes: No tax on wage income; interest & dividends tax fully repealed as of 2025.

NJ.notes: Single schedule. Newark 1% payroll tax is employer-side. NJ SDI/FLI/UI employee payroll contributions not modeled.

NM.notes: New 2025 bracket structure (HB 252, 2024). NM allows a deduction equal to the federal std deduction; $15,750 assumes rolling conformity to OBBBA (UNSURE - could be $15,000).

NV.notes: No state tax on wage income.

NY.notes: Tax benefit recapture: above $107,650 AGI the lower-bracket benefit is phased out, and above ~$25M the top rate applies to all income - not modeled. NYC resident income tax (3.078%-3.876%) and Yonkers surcharge NOT modeled. NY SDI/PFL payroll not modeled.

OH.notes: HB 96 (2025) cut the top rate from 3.5% to 3.125% for 2025, retroactive (TF shows 3.5%); flat 2.75% from 2026. Exemption $2,400 for AGI<=$40k, $2,150 for $40k-$80k, $1,900 above $80k; none above $750k. Municipal income taxes (typically 1.5%-2.5%, Columbus 2.5%, Cleveland 2.5%) and school district taxes NOT modeled.

OR.notes: 2025 values from OR Pub 17 (TF lists $11,050; ODR shows $11,100). Exemption credit $256, not allowed if AGI > $100,000. Federal income tax subtraction (up to $8,500 in 2025, phasing out for AGI $125k-$145k single) NOT modeled - it lowers OR tax by up to ~$740. Statewide transit tax 0.1%, Portland Metro SHS 1% and Multnomah PFA 1.5%+ (over $125k) local taxes NOT modeled.

PA.notes: Flat 3.07%, no deduction/exemption. Local Earned Income Taxes (typically ~1%; Philadelphia wage tax ~3.75% resident) and LST NOT modeled.

RI.notes: Std deduction and exemption phase out between ~$254k and ~$283k modified AGI. RI TDI payroll not modeled.

SC.notes: Top rate lowered to 6.0% for 2025 (SCDOR 2025 packet; TF showed 6.2%). Starting point is federal taxable income, but SC conforms to IRC as of 12/31/2024, so std deduction is the pre-OBBBA $15,000.

SD.notes: No state tax on wage income.

TN.notes: No state tax on wage income.

TX.notes: No state tax on wage income.

UT.notes: Rate cut to 4.5% for 2025 (HB 106, 2025). No deduction; instead a nonrefundable taxpayer tax credit = 6% of the federal std deduction ($15,750 x 6% = $945), reduced by 1.3% of income over $18,213 (single), so it is gone by ~$90.9k. Model: credit = max(0, 945 - 0.013*(income-18213)).

VA.notes: Std deduction raised to $8,750 for 2025-2026 by HB 1600 (2025) (TF shows $8,500).

VT.notes: 2025 VT rate schedule/booklet. If federal AGI > $150,000, tax is the greater of regular tax or 3% of AGI - not modeled.

WA.notes: No wage income tax; 7% (9.9% over $1M from 2025) tax on long-term capital gains over $270k only. WA Cares 0.58% and PFML employee payroll premiums not modeled.

WI.notes: 2025 Act 15 widened the 4.4% bracket to $50,480 retroactive to 2025 (TF shows $29,370). $13,560 is the maximum std deduction; it phases out on a sliding scale starting ~AGI $19.5k (single) and reaches $0 around ~$134k - estimator should apply the phase-out for accuracy.

WV.notes: 2025 rates after SB 2033 cuts. Some city service fees not modeled.

WY.notes: No state tax on wage income.
